title: observability: token-level metrics + tracing + dashboards + alert tuning
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: production customers and SRE reported noisy alerts and insufficient visibility into per-token cost and latency breakdowns for streaming/generation workloads. This PR adds token-level metrics and tracing hooks, ships Grafana dashboards for token-cost/latency and KV cache behavior, and tunes alert thresholds to reduce noise while preserving signal. Summary of changes: 1) Metrics: expose new Prometheus metrics: redwood_tokens_generated_total (labels: model, route, customer_tier), redwood_token_latency_seconds_bucket (model, route, latency_bucket), redwood_kv_cache_hit_total (model, cache_shard), and redwood_kv_cache_miss_total. Metrics include route-level and model-version labels to enable rollouts analysis. 2) Tracing: add token-generation spans for streaming pipeline with attributes (token_index, seq_len, model_variant, backend_latency_ms) and attach span IDs to request trace metadata for cross-service correlation. 3) Dashboards: new Grafana dashboards: Token Cost / Latency Breakdown (by model/route/customer), KV Cache Heatmap, Streaming Trace Explorer. Dashboards include derived panels for per-token cost (estimated cost = tokens * model_unit_cost) and P50/P95/P99 latency by token position. 4) Alerts: tune existing token-related alerts to be SLO-aware and route-aware, add adaptive thresholds for high-cardinality routes, and suppress noisy alerts for low-traffic routes via min_request_count. 5) Tests & docs: unit tests for metrics increments, integration test for trace propagation, and docs page with sample queries and runbook. Checklist: - [x] Metrics export implemented and unit-tested - [x] Tracing spans and propagation validated in integration tests - [x] Grafana JSON dashboards added and verified in staging - [x] Alert rules updated and noise tested in canary - [x] Docs and runbook updated - [x] Performance impact validated (<=1% median p99 token latency regression in staging) Commits: "a1b2c3: add token-level metrics and expose Prometheus counters and histograms; a2b3c4: add tracing spans for token generation and propagate trace id; a3b4c5: add Grafana dashboards for token cost/latency and KV cache heatmap; a4b5c6: alert tuning, add min_request_count and SLO-based thresholds; a5b6c7: tests and docs updates, performance validation notes".

Ethan Brooks: Alert tuning looks pragmatic. Suggest adjusting p99 threshold for model X by +15% based on recent traffic. Also please add SLO metadata to alert annotations so SRE can correlate.
